name: parse-web
description: Extract source-attributed main content from a fetched web page, or split an RSS/Atom feed into dated items that each keep their own link.
value: Extract source-attributed main content from a fetched web page, or split an RSS/Atom feed into dated items that each keep their own link.

source.notes: One successful fetched-text output; omitted means all prior fetched text outputs.

maxChars.notes: 500..10000 readable characters per source; default 6000, truncation disclosed.

items.notes: "feed": every RSS/Atom item becomes its own source {url, feed, title, published, text, textTruncated}; a page that is not a feed fails. Feed provenance (sourceSha256, counts) is in output.feeds.

since.notes: With items: feed, keep items published at or after this ISO date-time; may use {{env.NAME}}; an unresolved placeholder or a non-ISO value fails. Undated items are dropped when a window is set.

until.notes: With items: feed, keep items published before this ISO date-time; must be after since.

maxItemsPerSource.notes: With items: feed, 1..50 newest items per feed; default 10. At most 100 items in total.

itemChars.notes: With items: feed, 100..2000 characters of cleaned summary per item; default 400. Escaped HTML and entities are decoded and stripped.

document.notes: Title, main text, canonical URL and extraction diagnostics.

items.notes: items: feed — {sources, feeds, extraction, window}. The linked articles are not read; an empty window fails.

implementation.limitation: Candidate generic Registry route evidence; it is not public or user acceptance.

acceptance.scope: Controlled local installed Registry candidate run; this evidence is not public-release or owner acceptance.

evidence.coreSource: Q-Core candidate source checkout (claude/core34-registry20) before packing; live OpenRouter run 66c87653-651c-4503-ba3b-e0f3f6e319f1
